designDecisions: planReviewEmbedUrl/smartFilesEmbedUrl gain an OPTIONAL second cityKey parameter, appended via URLSearchParams (safe against injection). Omitting it preserves the exact prior behavior for server.mjs's own diagnostic /?work= example calls, which don't have a real city in scope.
compose.mjs threads its already-resolved `city` variable into both calls -- no new resolution logic needed, just wiring an existing value through.

On the downstream (plan-review, smart-files) side: read cityKey via the SAME pattern each app already uses for `embed` (new URL(location.href).searchParams.get(...)), for consistency with existing code in the same files.

Persona/CITY_KEY defaulting is gated on the cityKey PARAM BEING EXPLICITLY PRESENT, not on the fallback-applied effective value -- a bare standalone visit (no param at all, R-F/G-13) must keep its exact prior default behavior. This distinction was verified by explicit test cases in both isolated-logic checks, not assumed.

A city with no matching persona yet (anything but template-city, since Bastrop onboarding is explicitly out of scope) falls back to the prior default rather than fabricating a match -- fail-honest, not fail-silent.
